parameters.label: Threat Type
parameters.query:
union ProofPointTAPMessagesBlockedV2_CL, ProofPointTAPMessagesDeliveredV2_CL
| mv-expand todynamic(threatsInfoMap)
| extend threatType_ = tostring(threatsInfoMap.threatType)

content.query:
union ProofPointTAPMessagesBlockedV2_CL, ProofPointTAPMessagesDeliveredV2_CL
| mv-expand todynamic(threatsInfoMap)
| extend classification = tostring(threatsInfoMap.classification)
| extend threatType_ = tostring(threatsInfoMap.threatType)
| where classification in ({Classification}) or '*' in ({Classification})
| where threatType_ in ({ThreatType}) or '*' in ({ThreatType})
| summarize phish = countif(classification == 'phish'), malware = countif(classification == "malware"), impostor = countif(classification == "impostor"), spam = countif(classification == "spam") by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Message Events by Classification

content.query:

| where classification in ({Classification}) or '*' in ({Classification})
| summarize phish = countif(classification == "phish"), malware = countif(classification == "malware"), spam = countif(classification == "spam") by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})

content.query:
union withsource=Type ProofPointTAPClicksBlockedV2_CL, ProofPointTAPClicksPermittedV2_CL
| where classification in ({Classification}) or '*' in ({Classification})
| summarize ClicksBlocked = countif(Type == "ProofPointTAPClicksBlockedV2_CL"), ClicksPermitted = countif(Type == "ProofPointTAPClicksPermittedV2_CL") by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Clicks Blocked vs. Permitted

content.query:
union withsource=Type ProofPointTAPMessagesBlockedV2_CL, ProofPointTAPMessagesDeliveredV2_CL
| mv-expand todynamic(threatsInfoMap)
| extend classification = tostring(threatsInfoMap.classification)
| extend threatType_ = tostring(threatsInfoMap.threatType)
| where classification in ({Classification}) or '*' in ({Classification})
| where threatType_ in ({ThreatType}) or '*' in ({ThreatType})
| mv-expand todynamic(recipient)
| summarize MessagesBlocked = countif(Type == "ProofPointTAPMessagesBlockedV2_CL"), MessagesDelivered = countif(Type == "ProofPointTAPMessagesDeliveredV2_CL") by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Messages Blocked vs. Delivered

content.query:
ProofPointTAPClicksBlockedV2_CL
| extend URL = extract(@"\/\/(www.)?([a-zA-Z0-9-_.]+)(\/|$)",2,url)
| where classification in ({Classification}) or '*' in ({Classification})
| summarize phish = countif(classification == "phish"), malware = countif(classification == "malware"), spam = countif(classification == "spam"), count() by URL
| project-rename Total = count_
| top 10 by Total
content.title: Top 10 Clicks Blocked by Domain
